summary: Executed backend + frontend AI Design Studio validation against preview URL, including auth, AI proposal lifecycle, undo/redo, variants, mobile drawer, and PDF preview/download.

minor.issue: Follow-up refinement prompt intermittently returned 422 (safe-rejection) during live Gemini flow; no proposal rendered.

integration_issues.flow: AI modify existing design after manual edits
integration_issues.issue: Prompt 'Refine current layout...' returned AI safe-rejection (422) and proposal block did not appear.

action_items: Improve /api/ai/design robustness for modify/refine prompts so valid follow-up edits do not frequently 422 due strict intent/schema mismatches.
Consider better prompt-to-schema normalization for Gemini outputs (logs show invalid intent/property retries still ending in invalid output).
Review frontend/src/services/api.js fallback hardcoded backend URL/defaults to align with strict env-only requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/services/api.js uses fallback localhost/Render URL when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing; this violates strict env-only config requirement and can mask deployment misconfigurations.
Backend logs show repeated AI invalid_output cycles (Invalid design intent / invalid properties) before 422 response, indicating schema-adaptation gaps for some real Gemini responses.
seed_data_creation: Created/saved test templates via UI: TEST_AI_STUDIO_2026_10_04 and TEST_AI_STUDIO_VARIANT_2026_10_04.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core flows passed: create from blank, preview/cancel untouched canvas, apply, undo->0, redo restore, variant generation/apply, save/reopen, PDF preview/download, mobile drawer open/close, no mobile horizontal overflow. One live modify prompt failed with 422 safe rejection; reproduce from logged run 20261004_142430.
rca of the issue: RCA: backend aiSchema is intentionally strict; when Gemini returns operations/intents outside accepted schema, aiDesignService retries once then returns 422. Repro: after manual edit, send broad refine prompt -> backend log shows invalid_output/validation_reason and UI shows safety error instead of proposal. Mitigation: strengthen prompt guardrails + response repair/mapping before final schema validation.
